name: Four-position maintained selector
summary: A four-position maintained selector provides four stable operating choices.
description: A four-position maintained selector provides four stable operating choices. Each contact's state across those choices is recorded in a schedule instead of trying to express the complete logic in one contact outline.
readingNotes: Verify the sequence and order of all four positions.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Four positions do not imply four independent contact poles.
